unit_rate_from_pair.display_name: Compute a unit rate from a paired quantity

easy.statement_latex: A reader reads $360$ pages in $6$ days. What is the unit rate in pages per day?
hints: The unit rate is the amount per single time unit. Divide the total by the number of time units.
The unit rate is $60$ pages per day.
solution_steps_latex: Identify the pair: $360$ pages in $6$ days.
Divide the total by the time: $\dfrac{360}{6} = 60$.
The unit rate is $60$ pages per day.
